what_happened: Both measurement instruments the cost baseline needs already exist with no new dependency: Mathlib's #count_heartbeats in <cmd> (Mathlib/Util/CountHeartbeats.lean, present in the pinned v4.33.0-rc1 tree) and Lean.Expr.sizeWithoutSharing. Five lean_run_code probes produced the whole baseline inside research, including an exact closed form for lintro nesting cost (5n^2+17n+41, fitting n=2..16 with zero residual).

The research report measured the entire cost baseline inside the research dispatch (lintro term size exactly 5n^2+17n+41 over n=2..16, nested lrewrite exactly 785+346d over d=0..4, per-tier table, 13-row axiom table), so planning did not have to schedule discovery work: every implementation phase is harness check-in that reproduces an already-compiled figure. It also pre-refuted the obvious route by probing '#print axioms P6._example' -> Unknown constant, which forced the named-mirror design before any plan phase could be written against the acceptance fixtures.

Reading context/project/lean4/patterns/plan-authoring-gate-collisions.md before decomposing surfaced four same-phase obligations the research report had not enumerated: (1) .githooks/pre-commit blocks any commit staging a .lean path while typst/generated/status.typ is stale, and tests-file-count/tests-line-count are tracked fields, so every phase adding a Tests/ module owes an in-phase status.typ regeneration; (2) readme-lint.sh Check 1 (gated) requires a README.md in any directory containing .lean files, so BimodalLib/Diagnostics/ owes one; (3) readme-lint.sh Check 4 (gated, ENFORCE_README_DATES=1) makes BimodalLib/README.md's Last verified date newly stale the moment a subdirectory is added; (4) C30 forbids an unscoped set_option maxHeartbeats under FormalSystem/, Tests/ and scripts/, which rules out siting the timing probe under scripts/ and sends it to specs/evidence/ instead. All four are now scheduled phase work rather than mid-phase discoveries.

The research report explicitly deferred one decision to planning: whether the new computable derivation node-count measure lands in FormalSystem/ProofSystem/Derivation.lean beside height, or in BimodalLib/Diagnostics/. Decided for BimodalLib/Diagnostics/ on measured gate cost: touching Derivation.lean would move formalsystem-line-count in typst/generated/status.typ (commit-blocking), go stale the generated inventory row 'Derivation.lean | 418' in FormalSystem/ProofSystem/README.md, move the Live-lines-of-code totals block in README.md, make FormalSystem/ProofSystem/README.md's Last verified date newly stale, and oblige a full lake build --wfail of FormalSystem; siting it in BimodalLib/Diagnostics/ trips none of these four generated surfaces, because status.typ counts FormalSystem/, Tests/ and BimodalTools/ but not BimodalLib/. Recorded as a Decision in the plan with the trade-off stated.
